ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: SW — Shokk
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
SHOKK_SKIN_SHRINK_1 (2026-09-26, S6 ruling 1 — inverts the 2026-09-11 kit ruling 6 that first put the Wyyyschokk's mechanisms here) shrank this mod to a single skin patch. History: `SHOKK_RSW_MOD_1` (2026-09-11) originally built this mod's mechanisms against the third-party donor `Wyyyschokk` (`mlie.starwarsanimalcollection`) — the loom-bound hediff, the mouth-loom ranged spit, sun-scald, and an emergent-spawn comp. `OLLATHRIX_OWNER_SPECIES_1` (2026-09-26) then gave the free-tier biome mod `mandrake.rm.webwork` its own owner species, `RM_Ollathrix` (one race, one kind, invented and franchise-free per Q11a), and the owner ruled the same sitting that those mechanisms are mechanism-not-IP: they belong in `mandrake.rm.webwork` too, attached directly to `RM_Ollathrix`'s own def, not patched onto the third-party donor. `SHOKK_SKIN_SHRINK_1` carried that out — `RM_LoomBound`/`RM_Damage_LoomSpit`/`RM_Bullet_LoomSpit`/`RM_Gun_LoomSpit`/ `RM_Webwork_SunScald`/`RM_CompEmergentSpawnOnDestroy` all now live in `mandrake.rm.webwork`, and `RSW_Shokk_Wyyyschokk.xml` (the patch onto the donor) is retired — the donor's own `Wyyyschokk` no longer gets any of this mod's mechanics.
**What ships here now, and only this:**
`RSW_Shokk_OllathrixSkin.xml` (`OLLATHRIX_OWNER_SPECIES_1`, S6 ruling 6 — "the skin patch lives RSW, tier-correct for a Star Wars creature's LOOK, usable by any Star Wars scenario"). Overlays the canon Wyyyschokk identity (label, labelPlural, description, all three lifeStages' bodyGraphicData texPath) onto `RM_Ollathrix`'s SAME defName when this mod is loaded — one def, two skins, never a second race. It never touches mechanics.
`RSW_Shokk_FeraliskBrood.xml` (a DIFFERENT item, `FEVERWOOD_TWO_FRONT_LURE_1` — see that file's own header) — a hidden FactionDef the Fever Wood's `RM_MapComponent_TwoFrontLure` looks up by defName for its second raid front. It lives in this mod, not `RM_FeverWood`, because it references the donor `Wyyyschokk` PawnKindDef directly (genuine Star Wars IP, routed through this RSW-tier mod per Q11a) — unrelated to the skin/mechanism split above and untouched by `SHOKK_SKIN_SHRINK_1`.
**⚠️ Open naming question, flagged not resolved (`SHOKK_SKIN_SHRINK_1` close report has the full analysis):** `MLIE_FAUNA_ABSORPTION_1` (2026-09-18) separately ported the donor's Wyyyschokk in full as its own def, `RSW_Wyyyschokk` (`src/RimStarWars/SWBestiary/Defs/ThingDefs_Races/ RSW_Wyyyschokk.xml`) — a tameable, egg-laying, shearable, `TropicalRainforest`/ `TropicalSwamp`-weighted generic bestiary entry with `combatPower 600`, unrelated in every mechanical respect to `RM_Ollathrix` (untameable, ambush-hunting, `combatPower 160`, its own invented body/mechanics). Once this mod is loaded, a full campaign install carries TWO things labelled "wyyyschokk" — `RSW_Wyyyschokk` (its own defName, homeless, not wired into any biome's wildAnimals) and `RM_Ollathrix` wearing this mod's skin patch. Not a defName collision (the game loads both fine) but a genuine identity collision this item did not adjudicate. See the design doc's own §1c note and this item's close report.
Live proof is OWED beyond this mod's own prior quicktest verification of the mechanisms this description now says moved out — nothing left here to verify beyond the skin patch's static xpath match.
